summary: Reject failed and quality-invalid evidence in standard and SSOT decisions

delivery.outcome: Standard applicability and SSOT diagnostics defer failed, ambiguous or quality-invalid artifact evidence while preserving valid unrelated evidence. Independently reviewed merge and isolated installed regression smoke.
nonGoals: No adoption, source scanning, catalog changes, or global runtime replacement
Preserve foreign worktrees and new-project ticket325 writer

architecture.decision: Centralize stage/artifact provenance validation for SSOT and applicability; errors scoped to producing stage, artifact, component or repository invalidate only affected evidence. Read-only proposals retain separate authority and source freshness boundaries.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of evidence proof correction; no migration or data writes.

validation.evidence: Reproduce failed-stage and stage-scoped quality defects; ensure defer and unrelated evidence preservation.
Full tests, governance, exact-head independent review and merge.
Installed SSOT and applicability reject compromised evidence.
